# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Visual Design System

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, and completeness of UX and visual requirements for the Visual Design System feature
**Created**: 2026-09-20
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Traceability

- [x] CHK001 - Is the specification clearly traceable to GitHub Issue #9 (issue title, URL, labels, milestone) ? [Traceability, Spec §Traceability]
- [x] CHK002 - Are all acceptance criteria from the issue represented in the spec's User Scenarios & Testing section? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirement IDs or references present so reviewers can reference specific acceptance criteria? [Traceability, Spec §Requirements]

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK004 - Are design token categories (colors, typography, spacing, semantic tokens) fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §Requirements]
- [x] CHK005 - Are component patterns for core components (card, button, header, footer) specified with token mappings? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK006 - Are edge cases such as image-dominant content and small-screen long content explicitly addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 - Is the meaning of any vague term (e.g., "consistent", "prominent") quantified with measurable properties? [Clarity, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK008 - Are typography scale and specific sizes/examples provided so implementers can reproduce visual hierarchy? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements]
- [x] CHK009 - Are spacing rules described with a base unit or explicit token values? [Clarity, Spec §Requirements]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 - Do component styling requirements align between different sections (e.g., User Stories vs Requirements)? [Consistency, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing / §Requirements]
- [x] CHK011 - Are semantic token uses (success/warning/error) consistently defined across component examples? [Consistency, Spec §Requirements]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK012 - Are success criteria measurable and technology-agnostic (e.g., percent of pages, contrast thresholds stated as WCAG targets)? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK013 - Can each acceptance criterion be independently verified without implementation details? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario & Coverage

- [x] CHK014 - Are mobile, tablet, and desktop behaviors explicitly described or covered by acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [x] CHK015 - Are accessibility scenarios (keyboard navigation, focus states, semantic HTML) included for all interactive elements? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories / §Requirements]
- [x] CHK016 - Are zero-state and partial/failure data scenarios considered where applicable (e.g., missing images)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional (Accessibility / Performance)

- [x] CHK017 - Are accessibility targets specified (WCAG AA for body text) and referenced in the spec? [Accessibility, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK018 - Is there guidance on focus indicators, keyboard access, and meaningful alt text for images? [Accessibility, Spec §Requirements]

## Content Integrity & Gallery

- [x] CHK019 - Does the spec avoid inventing business content and require verified source material for brand/product claims? [Content Integrity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 - Are PDF gallery access requirements documented for mobile (touch/open behavior) and desktop? [Gallery, Spec §Dependencies]

## Git Workflow & Governance

- [x] CHK021 - Does the plan/spec follow the repository branching policy (work on feature branch, PR required) as described in the constitution? [Governance, Constitution §4]
- [x] CHK022 - Is the transition criterion to Ready described or referenced (what indicates spec+plan are sufficient)? [Governance, Constitution §6]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK023 - Are there any conflicting requirements or ambiguous scope boundaries that need clarification? [Ambiguity, Spec §Summary]

## Notes

- Items are reviewer-owned. Do not mark items `[x]` unless the reviewer confirms the requirement-quality criterion.
- This checklist focuses on requirement quality (not implementation tests).
- Add findings or links to review comments inline when marking items.
